mapper.select: select sys_id, call_cd, call_nm, single_yn, description from consumer_staff_call_setting where sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} order by insert_datetime asc, sys_id asc

select count(*) > 0 from sys_common_detail detail join sys_common_master master on master.sys_id = detail.link_sys_id where master.common_cd = 'STAFF_CALL_TYPE' and master.delete_yn = 'N' and master.use_yn = 'Y' and detail.common_cd = #{callCd} and detail.delete_yn = 'N' and detail.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into consumer_staff_call_setting (sys_id, call_cd, call_nm, single_yn, description, insert_datetime, sys_plant_cd) values (#{item.sysId}, #{item.callCd}, #{item.callNm}, #{item.singleYn}, #{item.description}, now(), #{sysPlantCd})
mapper.delete: delete from consumer_staff_call_setting where sys_id = #{sysId} and sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd}
